aggregation: arithmetic mean of front and rear joint angular velocities per side
candidate_feature_distance: time-aligned RMS of scaled right/left track velocity over 120 steps
candidate_information_decision: descriptive only, no thresholds optimized on 63 traces
candidate_ranking: six non-direct candidate distances to mean direct reference, pairwise concordance of 24j vs 2j; StateGroup is independent unit
duplicate_reference: three direct_reference runs per StateGroup; report pairwise RMS
field_phase: same step joint_velocity and pre_noise from saved trace; verify per-step before proxy comparison
missing_policy: reject; no zero filling or inferred joints
outcome_relationship: within-StateGroup Spearman of candidate track distance to direct against absolute direct-relative reward and goal difference; descriptive only
physical_equivalence: not assumed merely from joint identity
plot_data_policy: aggregate plots and derived timeseries only; no raw trace copied into Git
